text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, pardon the sudden intrusion. Have 
you seen a ladybug anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seven-spotted ladybugs, to be 
precise. Several of them that were in the 
field seem to be missing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
As the person entrusted with overseeing 
the ladybugs, I am conducting inquiries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You could say it's a personal hobby of 
mine, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Even the slightest detail would help. We 
currently have no leads whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ! ...Are you certain?

After splitting up to question the 
students, we got a promising lead. Rushing 
to the scene—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! Stop darting around! You're so 
tiny, yet so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ladybug! Be good and stay inside the magic 
circle!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—That is quite enough! Please let those 
children go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-Who's there?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We are from the Ladybug Management 
Association. Please return the kidnapped 
ladybug."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm going to use these little guys 
to make my magic work this time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A seven-spotted ladybug and a 
seven-pointed magic circle! I just feel 
like it's gonna work!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I know the feeling of wanting to cling 
to ladybugs for luck.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—I was just like that back when my father 
first taught me that ladybugs were a 
‘symbol of good luck.’”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Begging for ladybug-themed cakes... 
Schulranzen... Or polishing the brooch 
attached to my school backpack.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However—that was merely a symbol.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My father taught me that they are there to 
give you a push, but the one who takes 
action is yourself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to gain something, you should 
seize it with your own power. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san. Even if someone granted it for 
you, could you truly rejoice in that as 
your own achievement?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, fine, I get it! I just have to give 
it back, right?! I'll make the magic work 
with my own power!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Case closed, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Resolved 5 minutes and 53 seconds ahead of 
schedule. It's all thanks to dividing the 
work with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, if you'd like, would you care 
to join the 'Ladybug Care Society'?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To run around that much for a ladybug... I 
believe she has a true knack for it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Being alongside someone like that would 
be reassuring for me too. Of course, it 
won't affect our training."
choice_data_list: I might not have enough stamina...
If I can be of any help!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. If it's on top of your trainer 
duties, that is certainly true."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then let's start by building up some 
knowledge first.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Aller Anfang ist schwer... All beginnings 
are difficult. But once you master it, a 
whole new world will open up to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have the knowledge, next we'll 
build up stamina so we can keep up with a 
ladybug flying at 30 km/h.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. Ladybugs generally tend to 
stay rooted in their local habitat, so 
their travel distance is short—

Unable to bring myself to stop her as she 
spoke animatedly about ladybugs, I ended 
up attending her regular ladybug lectures.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Let's report to the other 
members right away, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Seeking to join this society? You 
clearly have an eye for greatness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ladybugs are beneficial insects that 
protect the flowers in fields and 
flowerbeds day and night.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Protecting that ladybug also helps protect 
the academy's environment, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For the academy, and for the ladybugs. Let 
us do our best together.

Afterward, Eishin Flash and I began making 
regular patrol rounds to check on the 
ladybugs.
